enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +23: Passive: +23 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Silver Flame Lore +18: Passive: Your Positive, Light, and Alignment spells gain a 18% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Silver Flame +122: Passive: +122 Equipment bonus to Positive, Light, and Alignment Spell Power.

Holy 5: This weapon is wielded by the pure to smite the wicked, dealing an additional 5d6 good damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon good aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +11 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.
Sacred +11: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Sacred items provide an +11 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
